title: HW 5: graph traversal
source: the HW 5 PDF, Lecture 16 and 17 slides, and the Ed thread on connected graphs

steps.text: Read the spec and the Ed clarification: the graph may not be connected
Review BFS and DFS on Lecture 16 slides 4 to 12
Write DFS that restarts from every unvisited vertex and counts components
Test on the three sample graphs, including one with isolated vertices
Write the complexity analysis for problem 4
Check the rubric line by line and zip the files
